name: Receipt and policy pre-check before submission
description: Before a claim is submitted, check every line against the travel policy and read the receipts (Arabic or English); tell the employee what to fix. Advisory only: it never rejects.
ai_technique: LLM reading receipts + rules for arithmetic
evidence: {rejected_share_pct} of cases ({rejected_cases_fmt}) have at least one rejection; administration rejects first in {first_rejected_by_admin_share_pct} of them; rejected cases take {throughput_p50_rejected_days_fmt} days at the median vs {throughput_p50_not_rejected_days_fmt} without a rejection. Staff themes: rejections and rework {T3_share_pct}, receipts {T2_share_pct} of snippets.

name: Approver assistant: reminders plus a one-line claim summary
description: Remind supervisors and budget owners about claims waiting more than N days, with a one-line AI summary (who, where, how much, anything unusual) so they can approve from the reminder.
evidence: The supervisor's final approval waits {supervisor_wait_p50_days_fmt} days at the median and {supervisor_wait_p90_days_fmt} at p90; supervisors are on {cases_via_supervisor_share_pct} of cases and hold {supervisor_share_of_waiting_pct} of all waiting time. Staff theme: approval delays {T4_share_pct}.

name: Arabic/English travel-policy Q&A assistant
description: A chat assistant that answers policy questions in Arabic or English and quotes the policy section it used.
evidence: Staff theme: policy unclear {T1_share_pct} of snippets; survey 'I understand what the policy allows' averages {q1_policy_clear_mean}/5.

name: Duplicate and split-bill anomaly flags for finance
description: Flag possible duplicate receipts and split bills (two claims just under a limit) for a finance clerk to review.
evidence: Staff theme: trust and control {T8_share_pct}. The event log has no line items or receipts, so the duplicate rate cannot be measured yet (data gap).

name: Weekly bottleneck report with an AI-written summary
description: Rebuild this diagnostic every week and send managers a short written summary of where claims wait.
evidence: {variants} different process paths; the payment stage holds {payment_stage_share_of_waiting_pct} of all waiting time. Today the numbers are built by hand (staff theme: manual work {T6_share_pct}).

name: 'Where is my claim?' status assistant
description: Employees ask in chat where their claim is and when it will be paid.
evidence: Staff theme: no status visibility {T5_share_pct}; survey 'I can see where my claim is' averages {q3_status_visible_mean}/5. The status exists in the database but is not shown to staff.

name: Receipt OCR and auto-fill of claim lines
description: Read a receipt photo and fill in date, vendor and amount on the claim form.
process_step: Employee, while filling in the claim
evidence: Staff theme: manual entry and duplicate work {T6_share_pct}; every line is typed by hand today.

name: Straight-through approval of low-value compliant claims
description: Claims under a set amount that pass every check go straight to payment; a human reviews a random sample.
process_step: Replaces supervisor approval for small claims
evidence: {top_variant_share_pct} of cases follow the most common path without rework; supervisors are on {cases_via_supervisor_share_pct} of cases.

name: Rejection-reason drafting assistant
description: When a clerk rejects a claim, draft a clear message: which rule, which line, and how to fix it.
ai_technique: LLM drafting, clerk edits and sends
evidence: After a rejection, employees take {employee_fix_wait_p50_days_fmt} days (median) and {employee_fix_wait_p90_days_fmt} (p90) to respond; {resubmitted_share_pct} of cases are resubmitted. Staff theme: rework {T3_share_pct}.

name: Approval-routing predictor
description: Predict which approvals a claim needs and skip the budget-owner step when the budget owner is also the supervisor.
evidence: {cases_via_budget_owner_share_pct} of cases wait for a budget owner as well as a supervisor.

name: Travel-spend forecasting per budget
description: Forecast travel spend per budget and show committed spend from claims still in the queue.
evidence: Weak link to the measured delays; one budget owner mentioned not seeing committed spend.

name: Finance-inbox triage and draft replies
description: Sort staff emails about claims and draft replies for the clerk to send.
evidence: Staff theme: no status visibility {T5_share_pct} (chasing emails); email volume is not in the log (not measured).

name: Arabic receipt translation for reviewers
description: Translate Arabic receipts into English for reviewers who cannot read them.
evidence: Staff theme: receipts and documents {T2_share_pct}, including Arabic receipts that reviewers cannot read.

name: Draft-claim completion nudges
description: Remind employees about claims saved as drafts and explain what is missing.
evidence: {saved_never_submitted_cases} claims were saved but never submitted in two years.

name: Policy-exception summary for internal audit
description: Summarise each month's flagged exceptions and rejections for internal audit.
evidence: Internal audit samples about 2% of claims by hand (interview); staff theme: trust and control {T8_share_pct}.

name: Per-diem and mileage calculator assistant
description: Work out per-diem and mileage amounts from the trip details instead of a separate spreadsheet.
process_step: Employee, while filling in the claim
evidence: Staff themes: policy unclear {T1_share_pct}, manual entry {T6_share_pct}.

name: Claim by photo and voice note (WhatsApp-style)
description: Field staff send receipt photos and a voice note; the assistant drafts the claim for them to confirm.
evidence: Staff theme: manual entry {T6_share_pct}; field engineers do several site visits a week (interviews).

name: Fraud-risk score per employee
description: Score each employee's claims history for fraud risk and send high scorers for extra checks.
evidence: Staff theme: trust and control {T8_share_pct}; staff asked to 'flag the claim, not the person'.

name: Daily payment run (no AI)
description: Pay approved claims every working day instead of twice a week.
evidence: From request to payment takes {payment_handled_wait_p50_days_fmt} days at the median, and the payment stage holds {payment_stage_share_of_waiting_pct} of all waiting time.

name: Corporate cards with a transaction feed (no AI)
description: Give frequent travellers corporate cards so they are not out of pocket; card lines arrive pre-filled.
evidence: Staff theme: payment timing {T7_share_pct}.
